Method of Attack: Join a Webex meeting as a ghost without being seen on the participant list with full access to audio, video, chat, and screen sharing capabilities
Stay in a Webex meeting as a ghost after being expelled from it, maintaining audio connection
Gain access to information on meeting attendees – including full names, email addresses, and IP addresses – from the meeting room lobby, even without being admitted to the call
Attack Vector: Exploiting the handshake process that Webex uses to establish a connection between meeting participants
